title: Robert Goddard rocket testing at Roswell

tellings.quote: I mean, Robert Goddard, who is a rocket pioneer in the US, had just been testing V2 rockets at it right at Roswell.

plain: Michels says the American rocket pioneer Robert Goddard had been testing V2 rockets right at Roswell, New Mexico, the town where in 1947 something crashed that UFO researchers believe was an alien craft. Michels tells it himself, without a source, as a hint that the area was already a centre of secret rocket work before the crash.
